one_line: LLMs edit weights directly, Anthropic ramps up compute, AI faces copyright lawsuits, OpenAI tightens security.

themes.title: LLMs edit neural weights directly
themes.text: MIT researchers showed that GPT‑6 Astra can modify a language model’s weights by changing only 0.016 % of parameters, raising MATH‑500 and GSM8K scores dramatically. Similar experiments reported a sixfold math improvement and threefold instruction gain without additional training.

stories.headline: MIT researchers show LLMs can read and edit neural network weights without retraining
GPT-6 Astra edits 0.016% of Qwen3.5-0.8B weights, boosting math performance sixfold

themes.title: Anthropic scales compute and revenue
themes.text: Anthropic disclosed roughly $895 billion in compute purchase commitments and reported a 1,100 % year‑over‑year revenue increase to $17 billion as it prepares for an IPO, while also noting slower growth and financing risks for AI compute.

stories.headline: Anthropic reports 1,100% revenue surge ahead of IPO, commits $895B to compute
Anthropic reports $895.4 billion in compute‑related purchase commitments and leases
Anthropic revenue growth slows as compute financing risks rise ahead of IPO

themes.title: AI faces copyright and content lawsuits
themes.text: The New York Times and other publishers sued Brave Software for scraping articles and enabling paywall bypass for AI firms, while an EU court adviser warned that Google’s Gemini chatbot may infringe press copyrights when reproducing paywalled content. Anthropic also added a rule to prevent Claude Code from cloning existing video games.

stories.headline: New York Times and other papers sue Brave over AI scraping and paywall bypass
EU court adviser says Google’s Gemini may infringe press copyright
Anthropic adds rule to stop Claude Code from cloning existing video games

themes.title: OpenAI expands security programs
themes.text: OpenAI increased bug bounty payouts and introduced new researcher bonuses, and partnered with Cathedral Systems to run an internal security sprint using AI to test and harden its defenses.

stories.headline: OpenAI raises security bug bounty rewards and adds new researcher bonuses
OpenAI teams with Cathedral Systems for next internal security sprint
